ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Hairline borders, subtle dividers, ghost surfaces — the dominant neutral that softens the white-on-white hierarchy

slate-veil.$description: Slate Veil — Muted body text, secondary metadata, nav placeholders — desaturated blue-gray reads as informational without competing with headlines

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text on light backgrounds, supporting copy, link underlines

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Emphasized body text, sub-labels, card headings on light surfaces

deep-forest.$description: Deep Forest — Headline color on white — the darkest near-black used for display copy, warmer than #15171a

carbon.$description: Carbon — Heavy borders on cards and dashboard panels — the border workhorse for dark UI elements

smoke.$description: Smoke — Icon strokes, secondary borders, disabled state outlines

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Maximum-contrast text on light, SVG fill for logos and icons

voltage-lime.$description: Voltage Lime — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

moss.$description: Moss — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lime-highlight.$description: Lime Highlight — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

amber-pulse.$description: Amber Pulse — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis.

interdisplay.$description: All display headlines, hero copy, section titles, link emphasis. Sizes scale aggressively from 18px subheads to 96px hero — the range itself is the brand. Weight 600 dominates at display sizes; 700 is reserved for the largest hero.

intervariable.$description: Body copy, nav items, button labels, list text, captions, table data. Weight 400 is the default; 500 for emphasized inline text; 600 for button labels and active nav. Never used above 15px — the hierarchy jumps from 15px body to 18px subhead, leaving a clear gap between reading text and display.
